commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text:
The one called a householder is a support to those forsaken by their protectors, to the poor, and to those who come to him with no one and die. He stands as protector to the forsaken, so that they stay free of sin, and does what they need. He gives the poor food and more. For the dead he does water rites and the like, and sends them to a good world.

துறந்தார் normally means those who have renounced, as in chapter 3. He reads it as those forsaken by their protectors.
